associated_communities: Practiced historically by martial lineages and warrior castes (such as Nairs and Ezhavas) across Northern and Southern Kerala traditions
distinctive_costumes_or_props: Kachakettal (waistband), Urumi (flexible curved sword), sword and shield (Vaalum Parichayum), wooden staff (Kettukari)
musical_instruments_used: Traditional percussion rhythm accompaniment using Chenda and Thudi during combat training demonstrations
unesco_status: Inscribed on India's National Inventory of Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH)
